The '''Southern Ewok Lake Village''',<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68214&month=022009|text=Friday Feature – So This Is Love}}</ref> also simply known as the '''Ewok Lake Village''', was a small [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Ewok stilt village/Legends|stilt village]] located on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was inhabited by the Ewoks of the [[Gondula]] tribe. They kept a herd of [[Bordok/Legends|bordoks]] in a pen on the beach facing the village. The Gondula tribe also inhabited [[Ewok Lake Village (north)|another stilt village]] further to the northeast.<ref name="SWG:ELV" />

[[File:SWG-EwokFestivalofLove2010.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ewoks celebrating the [[Festival of Love]]]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the village hosted the Ewok [[Festival of Love]]. Many spacers from all around the galaxy therefore traveled to the village to celebrate the festival.<ref name="SWG:EFoL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Ewok Festival of Love|Endor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Southern Ewok Lake Village was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ELV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, there were two Ewok stilt villages and both were simply called an "Ewok Lake Village,"<ref name="SWG:ELV" /> however the game's directory tree files and source data give the more specific name of '''Gondula Ewok Fishing Village'''.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|directory tree files and source data}}</ref>
